correctness.rationale: A singleton at positive distances has a realizable distance vector exactly when the Katětov inequalities hold. Arbitrarily many copies at mutual distance 1 prove nonalgebraicity, and homogeneity makes the vector determine its type. With center value x and leaves y_i, the leaf-pair condition is y_i+y_k>=4, so a unique value-1 leaf, when allowed, forces the others to be at least 3. Splitting by x=1,2,3,4 gives (1+z)^n+nz, two copies of (2+z)^n+n2^(n-1)z, and (2+z)^n. Only coefficient 1 is raised relative to b_j=binom(n,j)(1+3·2^(n-j)). At internal j the reference inequality is 2(n+1)(1+t)^2>j(n-j)t with t=3·2^(n-j)>n-j. The sole possible failure is consequently grade 2, whose exact Turán bracket is (33-3n)Q²+(136-32n)Q+80-16n, Q=2^n. For n=3–5 its sign is positive directly; for n=6–10 it is at least 3Q²-184Q-80>0; for n>=11 it is negative. There is no internal grade 2 for n=1,2. Unimodality follows from c_0<=c_1, c_2<c_1 and c_3<c_2 when those grades exist for n<=7, and the initial rise followed by a log-concave tail when n>=8. Normalizing the polynomial gives a mixture with Bin(n,1/3) weight 3^(n+1)/F_n(1), proving the total-variation bound. The supplied artifacts/check_star_types.py and VERIFICATION.md were inspected, not executed. A separately written check (branches/50f06070-eb21-4db8-9bb4-e54dddd1d215/independent_star_check.py, check-complete.log) enumerated vectors through n=7 and checked exact coefficients and shape through n=300. At n=11 the grade-2 difference -2788445 was also recomputed from coefficients, not exhaustive distance-vector enumeration. The infinite claim follows from the sign and shape arguments, not the finite observations.

value.rationale: The star with leaf distances twice the radius is a natural metric family, and grading by the distances up to that radius is meaningful. The result isolates a low-grade obstruction to log-concavity at a sharp finite threshold, proves it is the only failure at every larger size, and exhibits why an exponentially small total-variation error does not control that local statistic. The value is in this classification and contrast, not just an elementary count of feasible vectors.
